display_information.name: opencode
display_information.description: Interact with opencode — your AI coding agent — from Slack. DM or @mention to run tasks, review code, or ask questions.
display_information.long_description: DM or @mention this bot to invoke opencode on your development machine. opencode processes your request and returns the response in-thread. Supports code generation, debugging, code review, refactoring, and more.
